verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere ships an official CLI (Wally) that runs local models offline without an account and hosted models via `--cloud`. Its docs say one command points a tool such as opencode at a model and starts it, which implies a terminal session with a model. The evidence never documents a native interactive chat/REPL command, though: the terminal interaction appears to come through launching a third-party tool. Hands-on reports of the rcli terminal app are mixed: one user called it a fun demo, while others hit segfaults and install failures. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented first-party interactive chat command, details of the conversational session (history, multi-turn), and reliable independent hands-on corroboration.
